name: web-orange-gradient-monospace-product-page-headphones
title: Ring Headphones Product Page
whatItIs: A product page presented on an orange-red gradient: a light gray window with a huge grayscale render of ring-shaped headphones in the center, left panel with description, specs and gallery, right panel with price, rating, colors, edition and availability, and an orange CTA.
whatItMeans: A neutral gray interface lets the product and one hot orange accent dominate. Monospace headings with periods feel like a technical spec sheet.
techniques: Oversized central product render breaking into the side panels
Monospace headings ending in periods for a spec-sheet voice
Single orange accent for CTAs, selected states and progress
Modular side panels split by hairlines

vocabulary.definition: A structured list of attributes in a compact, labeled format.
A large 3D image of the product as the page's centerpiece.
Restricting saturated color to interactive and selected elements.
